xref.title: Collaborations and Composer Career
xref.body: After years working as "Wendy and Lisa" with Lisa Coleman, Melvoin returned to Prince's projects from 2004 to 2007, participating in tours and albums. She has collaborated with Rob Thomas, Madonna, Neil Finn and Campbell, Seal, and K.D. Lang, and is also an in-demand composer for TV and film, with credits on "Heroes" and "Nurse Jackie." "She's also an in-demand composer for TV and film, shows like Heroes and Nurse Jackie."

xref.title: International Acclaim and Fanbase
xref.body: Led by singer Neil Finn, the band achieved global recognition and a series of best-selling albums between 1985 and 1996, garnering fans worldwide, including Eddie Vetter of Pearl Jam. "They found fans around the world. Eddie Vetter of Pearl Jam just loved these guys."

xref.title: Post-Smiths Career as Session Guitarist
xref.body: After The Smiths' breakup, Johnny Marr became a highly sought-after session guitarist. He worked and toured with The Pretenders and Dada, and later co-founded Electronic with Barney Sumner of New Order. He also became a friend and confidante of Noel Gallagher of Oasis, collaborating with him in the studio, and worked with artists like Beth Orton, Neil Finn, Paul McCartney, and Talking Heads. "Meanwhile, Johnny Mar became a very hot session guitarist, working in touring with the pretenders in Dada."
